Definition Template 0)\n581\t\n582\t**Characteristics:**\n583\t- **Shape:** Earth represented as regular lat/lon grid\n584\t- **Projection:** Geographic (no projection distortion)\n585\t- **Spacing:** Uniform in both latitude and longitude\n586\t- **Extent:** Global (90°N to -90°N, 0°E to 359.75°E for GFS)\n587\t\n588\t**Parameters:**\n589\t- `Ni`: Number of points along latitude circle (varies by resolution)\n590\t- `Nj`: Number of points along longitude meridian (varies by resolution)\n591\t- `Di`: Longitudinal direction increment (varies by resolution)\n592\t- `Dj`: Latitudinal direction increment (varies by resolution)\n593\t\n594\t**CONUS Compatibility:**\n595\t- CONUS bounds (20°N-50°N, 125°W-65°W) are subset of global grid\n596\t- No interpolation or projection issues over CONUS\n597\t- Uniform resolution across CONUS without edge effects\n598\t\n599\t### File Naming Convention\n600\t\n601\t**Pattern:** `gfs.YYYYMMDD/HH/atmos/gfs.tHHz.pgrb2.RESOLUTION.FFH`\n602\t\n603\t**Components:**\n604\t- `gfs`: Model identifier (Global Forecast System)\n605\t- `YYYYMMDD`: Model run date (e.g., 20260724)\n606\t- `HH`: Cycle hour (00, 06, 12, 18)\n607\t- `atmos`: Atmospheric model (vs. ocean/wave)\n608\t- `tHHz`: Forecast cycle (e.g., t00z for 00Z cycle)\n609\t- `pgrb2`: Product GRIB2 format\n610\t- `RESOLUTION`: Grid spacing (0p25=0.25°, 0p50=0.50°, 1p00=1.00°)\n611\t- `FFH`: Forecast hour (000=analysis, 003=3-hour, ..., 384=16-day)\n612\t\n613\t**Example:** `gfs.20260724/00/atmos/gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p50.f000`\n614\t- GFS model from 2026-07-24 00Z cycle\n615\t- 0.50° resolution\n616\t- F000 = analysis time (0-hour forecast)\n617\t\n618\t### Download Performance Formula\n619\t\n620\t**Calculation:**\n621\t```\n622\tDownload Time (seconds) = File Size (bytes) / (Connection Speed (bps) × 60 seconds)\n623\t\n624\tConnection Speeds:\n625\t- 100 Mbps = 12.5 MB/s = 100,000,000 bps\n626\t- 10 Mbps = 1.25 MB/s = 10,000,000 bps  \n627\t- 1 Mbps = 0.125 MB/s = 1,000,000 bps\n628\t```\n629\t\n630\t**Examples:**\n631\t- 145 MB @ 100 Mbps: 145 MB / 12.5 MB/s = 11.6 seconds\n632\t- 145 MB @ 10 Mbps: 145 MB / 1.25 MB/s = 116 seconds (1:56)\n633\t- 490 MB @ 100 Mbps: 490 MB / 12.5 MB/s = 39.2 seconds\n634\t\n635\t### Related Appendix\n\n### Grid Template 0 Specification\n\n**Definition:** Regular Latitude-Longitude Grid (WMO GRIB2 Grid Definition Template 0)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- **Shape:** Earth represented as regular lat/lon grid\n- **Projection:** Geographic (no projection distortion)\n- **Spacing:** Uniform in both latitude and longitude\n- **Extent:** Global (90°N to -90°N, 0°E to 359.75°E for GFS)\n\n**Parameters:**\n- `Ni`: Number of points along latitude circle (varies by resolution)\n- `Nj`: Number of points along longitude meridian (varies by resolution)\n- `Di`: Longitudinal direction increment (varies by resolution)\n- `Dj`: Latitudinal direction increment (varies by resolution)\n\n**CONUS Compatibility:**\n- CONUS bounds (20°N-50°N, 125°W-65°W) are subset of global grid\n- No interpolation or projection issues over CONUS\n- Uniform resolution across CONUS without edge effects\n\n### File Naming Convention\n\n**Pattern:** `gfs.YYYYMMDD/HH/atmos/gfs.tHHz.pgrb2.RESOLUTION.FFH`\n\n**Components:**\n- `gfs`: Model identifier (Global Forecast System)\n- `YYYYMMDD`: Model run date (e.g., 20260724)\n- `HH`: Cycle hour (00, 06, 12, 18)\n- `atmos`: Atmospheric model (vs. ocean/wave)\n- `tHHz`: Forecast cycle (e.g., t00z for 00Z cycle)\n- `pgrb2`: Product GRIB2 format\n- `RESOLUTION`: Grid spacing (0p25=0.25°, 0p50=0.50°, 1p00=1.00°)\n- `FFH`: Forecast hour (000=analysis, 003=3-hour, ..., 384=16-day)\n\n**Example:** `gfs.20260724/00/atmos/gfs.t00z.pgrb2.0p50.f000`\n- GFS model from 2026-07-24 00Z cycle\n- 0.50° resolution\n- F000 = analysis time (0-hour forecast)\n\n### Download Performance Formula\n\n**Calculation:**\n```\nDownload Time (seconds) = File Size (bytes) / (Connection Speed (bps) × 60 seconds)\n\nConnection Speeds:\n- 100 Mbps = 12.5 MB/s = 100,000,000 bps\n- 10 Mbps = 1.25 MB/s = 10,000,000 bps  \n- 1 Mbps = 0.125 MB/s = 1,000,000 bps\n```\n\n**Examples:**\n- 145 MB @ 100 Mbps: 145 MB / 12.5 MB/s = 11.6 seconds\n- 145 MB @ 10 Mbps: 145 MB / 1.25 MB/s = 116 seconds (1:56)\n- 490 MB @ 100 Mbps: 490 MB / 12.5 MB/s = 39.2 seconds\n\n### Related Documentation\n\n**Project
